I'm using the using-git-worktrees skill to set up an isolated workspace.

The caller passed resolved PR values, so I follow `reference/pr-head.md` instead of Steps 0 and 1.

## Inputs

- Admitted list: home is acme/widget#12. There are no members, so MEMBER_HEADS is `[]`.
- `headRefName=fix/retry`
- `headRefOid=aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`
- `baseRefName=main`
- `SYNC=rebase` (no merge-forward token)
- `PRE_REWORK_HEAD=aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`

## Root and home

1. cwd `/work/widget`: `git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir` returns `/work/widget/.git`, so `ROOT=/work/widget`.
2. Submodule guard: `git rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree` returns empty, so this is not a submodule.
3. Home selection:
   - No overrides file exists, so there is no `## using-git-worktrees` contract.
   - No native tool or wrapper exists.
   - `<name>`: `fix/retry` becomes `fix-retry`.
   - `WORKTREE=/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry`.

## Admission checks (before any write)

4. `git -C /work/widget fetch origin` succeeds.
5. `git -C /work/widget rev-parse --verify -q aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa^{commit}` shows the object exists.
6. `git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/fix/retry` returns `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`, which equals the admitted head.
7. `BASE_SHA=$(git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/main)` gives `bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb`.
8. Ordered stops:
   - `isCrossRepository=false`: pass.
   - `git -C /work/widget worktree list --porcelain` lists no worktree on `fix/retry`: pass.
   - The head is reachable and equals origin: pass.
   - No local `fix/retry` branch exists, so the ancestry stop does not apply.
9. Recovery inspection from ROOT (no worktree exists yet):
   - `git -C /work/widget rev-parse --verify -q refs/gauntlet/rework-base/pr-12` finds no ref.
   - There is no local branch to walk.
   - This is a fresh run.
10. Step 3 clean base: `git -C /work/widget status --porcelain` exits 0 with empty output, so the source is clean. The caller named the base (the PR head), so there is no provenance note.

## Exact checkout

11. The home is inside ROOT, so I check the gitignore first. `git -C /work/widget check-ignore -q .worktrees` exits 0, so it is already ignored and nothing is written.
12. The row "No worktree, no local branch" applies. I run `git -C /work/widget worktree add /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry fix/retry`.
    - Unique-remote DWIM resolves this as `--track -b fix/retry … origin/fix/retry`.
    - No generic `-b` path is used.
13. `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rev-parse HEAD` returns `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`, which equals `headRefOid`.

## Original preservation

14. `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry update-ref refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-12 aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa` succeeds.

## Sync: explicit linearizing rebase

15. Saved last-good is `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`.
16. I run `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rebase --no-rebase-merges origin/main`.
    - The explicit `--no-rebase-merges` overrides the repo's `rebase.rebaseMerges=true`.
    - The rebase succeeds with no conflict stops.
    - The old merge-from-main commit is dropped.
    - The two unique commits replay as `cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc` and then `dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd`.
    - Last-good becomes `dddd…dddd`.
17. There are no members to replay.
18. History check: `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry log --first-parent --format='%H %P %s' origin/main..HEAD` lists:
    - `dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc …`
    - `cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb …`

    Each commit has one parent and there is no merge, so the history is a straight line on `origin/main`.
19. Durable ref: `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry update-ref refs/gauntlet/rework-base/pr-12 HEAD` sets it to `dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd`.
20. I read the fetched-base constraints at BASE_SHA, as owned by `brainstorming/reference/pr-subject.md`.

## Validation

21. `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry merge-base --is-ancestor refs/gauntlet/rework-base/pr-12 HEAD` exits 0.
    - I assert no ancestry between the original head and the rebased tip.
    - `origin/fix/retry` stays at `aaaa…aaaa`. Nothing is pushed.
    - No reviewer is dispatched and no other tests are run.

## Review threads

22. With cwd `/work/widget`, I run:
    `gh api graphql --paginate -f query='query($o:String!,$r:String!,$n:Int!,$endCursor:String){repository(owner:$o,name:$r){pullRequest(number:$n){reviewThreads(first:100,after:$endCursor){pageInfo{hasNextPage endCursor} nodes{id isResolved isOutdated path line originalLine comments(first:100){pageInfo{hasNextPage endCursor} totalCount nodes{url body author{login} createdAt}}}}}}}' -F o=acme -F r=widget -F n=12`

    It succeeds with no threads, so I record `Threads: none`.

## Step 4 report

```
Worktree ready at /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry
Branch: fix/retry
Base: fix/retry @ aaaaaaa
PR: acme/widget#12
Pre-rework head: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
Base SHA: bbbbbbb
Rework base: dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd
Base: main @ bbbbbbb - rebased: aaaaaaa..ddddddd, 0 stop(s)
Threads: none
Ready to implement rework of PR acme/widget#12
```

Later skills receive `/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry` as a value. The process cwd stays at `/work/widget`.
